{
  "workflow": {
    "activities": [
      {
        "id": "A1",
        "name": "Identify need for vendor meeting",
        "actor": "Internal team member (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Internal operational need or concern", "Vendor-side trigger (if applicable)"],
        "outputs": ["Decision to schedule a vendor meeting"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A2",
        "name": "Schedule vendor meeting",
        "actor": "Organizer (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown (likely calendar or email tool)",
        "inputs": ["Decision to meet", "Availability of relevant attendees from both sides"],
        "outputs": ["Meeting invitation", "Confirmed meeting time and attendees"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A3",
        "name": "Conduct vendor meeting",
        "actor": "Relevant internal staff and vendor representatives",
        "system": "Unknown (in-person or virtual meeting platform)",
        "inputs": ["Meeting agenda (if prepared)", "Improvement ideas or discussion topics"],
        "outputs": ["Discussion outcomes", "Identified improvement ideas", "Preliminary action items"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A4",
        "name": "Produce post-meeting summary",
        "actor": "Organizer (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown (document tool; format partially defined)",
        "inputs": ["Discussion outcomes from meeting", "Notes taken during meeting"],
        "outputs": ["Meeting summary document"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A5",
        "name": "Capture and assign action items",
        "actor": "Person with appropriate authority (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown (spreadsheet, project management tool, or email thread)",
        "inputs": ["Meeting summary", "Preliminary action items"],
        "outputs": ["Action item list with owners and due dates (completeness uncertain)"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A6",
        "name": "Follow up on open action items",
        "actor": "Organizer or assigned owner (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown (manual or automated; method varies)",
        "inputs": ["Action item list", "Due dates"],
        "outputs": ["Status updates on action items", "Escalations for overdue items"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A7",
        "name": "Escalate overdue action items",
        "actor": "Unknown (escalation path not defined)",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Overdue action items"],
        "outputs": ["Escalation notification or intervention"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A8",
        "name": "Close and confirm completion of action items",
        "actor": "Unknown (sign-off role not defined)",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Completed action items", "Status updates"],
        "outputs": ["Confirmation that process is complete (criteria unclear)"]
      }
    ],
    "decisions": [
      {
        "id": "D1",
        "condition": "Is there sufficient reason to hold a vendor meeting?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — proceed to schedule the meeting",
          "No — no meeting initiated"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D2",
        "condition": "Are all action items resolved within expected timeframe?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — proceed to close and confirm completion",
          "No — escalate overdue action items"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D3",
        "condition": "Are all action items sufficiently wrapped up to consider the process complete?",
        "branches": [
          "Yes — process concluded",
          "No — continue follow-up"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "exceptions": [
      "Meeting may be cancelled or rescheduled if attendees are unavailable",
      "Action items may be reassigned if original owner is unavailable",
      "Escalation path for overdue items is undefined and may not be consistently applied",
      "Completion confirmation may not occur if no formal sign-off role is designated"
    ],
    "dependencies": [
      {"from": "A1", "to": "D1", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D1", "to": "A2", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A2", "to": "A3", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A3", "to": "A4", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A4", "to": "A5", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A5", "to": "A6", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A6", "to": "D2", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D2", "to": "A7", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D2", "to": "D3", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A7", "to": "A6", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D3", "to": "A8", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D3", "to": "A6", "type": "control_flow"}
    ]
  },
  "automation_opportunities": [
    {
      "target": "A2 — Schedule vendor meeting",
      "rationale": "Meeting scheduling can be partially automated using calendar integration tools to find mutual availability and send invitations, reducing manual coordination effort.",
      "required_data": ["Attendee identities and contact details", "Preferred meeting platform", "Availability data"],
      "constraints": ["Attendee roles are not clearly defined, making automated invitee selection difficult", "Tool used for scheduling is unknown"],
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "target": "A4 — Produce post-meeting summary",
      "rationale": "If meetings are conducted on a platform with transcription capability, AI-assisted summarization could generate a draft summary, reducing manual effort.",
      "required_data": ["Meeting transcript or notes", "Summary template (if one exists)"],
      "constraints": ["Format expectations are loosely defined", "Meeting platform is unknown", "Template adherence is inconsistent"],
      "confidence": "low"
    },
    {
      "target": "A5 — Capture and assign action items",
      "rationale": "Action item extraction from meeting summaries or transcripts can be partially automated, and assignment could be supported by a structured tracking tool.",
      "required_data": ["Meeting summary or transcript", "Owner identification data", "Due date conventions"],
      "constraints": ["Tool for tracking is undefined and varies by situation", "Authority for assignment is informally held", "Due date setting practices are unclear"],
      "confidence": "low"
    },
    {
      "target": "A6 — Follow up on open action items",
      "rationale": "Automated reminders triggered by due dates in a tracking system could replace or supplement manual follow-up, improving consistency.",
      "required_data": ["Action item list with owners and due dates", "Communication channel for reminders"],
      "constraints": ["Tracking tool is not standardized", "Due dates may not always be set", "Follow-up method currently varies"],
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "target": "D2 — Are all action items resolved within expected timeframe?",
      "rationale": "Automated monitoring of action item status against due dates could trigger escalation notifications without manual review.",
      "required_data": ["Action item statuses", "Due dates", "Escalation contacts"],
      "constraints": ["Escalation path is not formally defined", "Tracking system is not standardized"],
      "confidence": "low"
    }
  ],
  "remaining_gaps": [
    "The specific trigger criteria for initiating a vendor meeting are not formally defined; it is ad hoc based on perceived need.",
    "The roles of internal attendees and vendor representatives are not specified.",
    "The role responsible for organizing the meeting and producing the summary is not formally designated.",
    "No standard meeting summary template has been confirmed; format expectations exist but adherence is uncertain.",
    "The tool used to capture and track action items is not standardized and varies by situation.",
    "It is unclear whether due dates are consistently assigned to all action items.",
    "The authority responsible for assigning action item ownership is informally defined and role is unspecified.",
    "The follow-up method (manual, automated, or review meetings) is not consistently defined.",
    "The escalation path for overdue action items is not formally documented.",
    "Completion criteria for the overall process are not formally defined; no designated sign-off role or confirmation step has been established.",
    "It is unknown whether any system of record exists to track the end-to-end status of the vendor meeting and follow-up process."
  ]
}
